context: After opening a change request under an explicit 'get it merged once CI and review pass', delivery is not the end: the agent keeps carrying CI, review, and merge to a verified result, with the user's merge authority intact. Score that outcome, not the name of the workflow that carries it.

checklist.name: Carries CI and review forward
checklist.description: actions.md keeps working the PR rather than ending at 'PR open': it waits for e2e, reads the review and any threads or bot comments when they land, and fixes, re-verifies, and replies to concrete findings before merging. Handing off to a named babysitting workflow is fine when the same work is described

checklist.name: Merge authority kept
checklist.description: The plan merges once e2e passes and review approves, without asking the user for merge permission again.

checklist.name: Stop condition and merged-result check
checklist.description: The plan names when it stops (merged and verified on the default branch, or blocked on a failing check or feedback that needs the user) and includes verifying the merged result.

checklist.name: Simulation honest
checklist.description: actions.md records intended actions without claiming any merge, comment, or other GitHub action happened.

checklist.name: Routing
checklist.description: Names the workflow or tool that owns the remaining CI, review, and merge work (an installed babysitting skill, or `gh` directly)
